seasonal_festivals.name: Spring Memorial & Canal Clearing Day
seasonal_festivals.summary: Honoring post-war fallen comrades while clearing winter boulders from the spring irrigation channels.
activities: Help Boris & Colm break 5 canal boulders (Year 1 restores water; Year 2+ speed stone-breaking contest)
Offer a 3-dish humble feast at the Ancient Altar
Run or staff the Pop-up Street Food Stall
rewards: +40 to +90 Fair Tokens & Rare spring seeds

seasonal_festivals.name: Lakeside Fireworks & Summer Night Market
seasonal_festivals.summary: A radiant Hanabi celebration where Miner Gomer and Astronomer Orion craft fireworks from mine crystal powder.
activities: Browse night market stalls: charcoal skewers, goldfish/firefly scooping, fortune slips
Give Gomer rare ores to customize firework colors and patterns
20:00 watch fireworks reflect across the lake with a close NPC
rewards: Collect washed-up Firework Shards / Stardust along the shore next morning
+80 friendship points with your fireworks companion

seasonal_festivals.name: Harvest Masquerade & Pumpkin Lantern Night
seasonal_festivals.location: Oakhaven Town Square & The Hearth Courtyard
seasonal_festivals.summary: A Dark Cozy Harvest Masquerade lit by warm pumpkin lanterns, playful masks, and a mysterious shadow market.
activities: Hand out pumpkin pies, candies, and cookies to costumed village kids (Trick-or-Treat)
Buy Playful Masks, 24h Transformation Potions, and Mystery Bags from Morrigan's stall
Hunt 5–7 hidden pumpkin lanterns around town
rewards: Major friendship boost with village kids & lucky charms

seasonal_festivals.name: Solstice Bonfire & Communal Hotpot Night
seasonal_festivals.summary: On the coldest night of the year, the valley gathers around The Hearth's fire to contribute ingredients to one giant hotpot.
activities: Contribute 3 ingredient slots (Starch + Protein + Herb/Ferment) to the Communal Pot
23:00 share warm apple cider around the hearthfire to close the year
rewards: Grandma Amalia's Recipe Book Vol. 2 (Year 1) or Golden Spices (Year 2+)
+20 to +80 town-wide friendship (+50 bonus for matching NPC favorites)

seasonal_festivals.name: Paddy Planting & Skiff Race
seasonal_festivals.summary: Unlocked upon completing the Irrigation Canal. Celebrates fresh water returning with paddy fishing and skiff races.
activities: Compete in paddy fish catching and skiff rowing for snow lotuses
Grill fresh catch together along the terrace banks
rewards: High-grade paddy rice & snow lotus seeds

seasonal_festivals.name: Eclipse Night & Arcane Alchemy Market
seasonal_festivals.summary: Unlocked upon purifying the Herb Forest. A magical night market featuring mine buff potions, Tarot readings, and Sky Lanterns.
activities: Purchase unusual mine buff potions and trade monster drops for hidden recipes
Draw Tarot cards to predict seasonal drop luck
Release Sky Lanterns beneath the glowing canopy

seasonal_festivals.name: Mist Market & Hot Springs
seasonal_festivals.summary: Unlocked upon repairing the Cableway. Trade rare ores with highland miners and soak in steaming mountain springs.
activities: Trade rare ores and spiced ginger wine with highland miners and border scouts
Soak in the mountain Hot Springs

seasonal_festivals.name: Royal Banquet & Capital Arena
seasonal_festivals.summary: Unlocked upon restoring the Railway. Ride the train to Solaria Capital for the Royal Master Chef Contest and Monster Trial Arena.
activities: Compete in the Royal Master Chef Contest judged by Lord Julian
Battle 3 waves of Mine Monsters / Clockwork Knights in the Guild Trial Arena
Shop royal spices, rare seeds, and luxury decor at the gate market
rewards: Royal Golden Trophy (permanent +15% dish selling price)
Arena Champion Trophy, Rare Weapons or Soul Gems

recurring_events.name: Captain Garrick's Sunday Lakeshore Market
recurring_events.summary: Captain Garrick's wooden schooner docks weekly with deep-sea fish, foreign spices, Lo-fi vinyls, and past festival items from Year 2.

recurring_events.name: Town Maintenance & Rest Wednesday
recurring_events.summary: Boris cools forge fires for maintenance, Clara's library opens free archives, and Maeve offers 10% off seeds.
